_doc: Golden fixture for issue #136 — the FROZEN recipe contract. Downstream Wave-1 work (#138 design tables, #139 feature templates, #146 registry) builds against this shape. Two parts: (1) `component` — the recipe-reference manifest component form, a fourth source kind alongside file/manifest/library; (2) `input_schema` — the declared per-recipe input schema returned by recipe_schema('spur_gear'). tests/test_recipes.py asserts the live registry matches this fixture exactly.

input_schema.doc: Involute spur gear (wraps add_gear): a solid disc of teeth on the XY plane about +Z, publishing a 'gear_mesh' frame at its axis and declaring a watertight-solid intent. The canonical reference recipe (issue #136).

inputs.name: module_mm
inputs.doc: Gear module (tooth size); pitch_dia = module * teeth.

inputs.name: teeth
inputs.doc: Number of teeth (>=3 for a valid involute).

inputs.name: pressure_angle_deg
inputs.doc: Involute pressure angle (14.5/20/25 deg are standard).
